goals.0: Asking and saying where things are
goals.2: The Dativ for location: dem / der
goals.3: liegen and stehen — things lying down and things standing
dialog.1.de.3.n: To answer wo? use the Dativ: der Tisch → dem Tisch
dialog.5.de.1.n: The book stands upright here → steht (kept upright on the shelf)
grammar.0.title: Wo? — the Dativ for location
grammar.0.intro: After in, auf, neben, unter, vor, hinter, the Dativ is used to answer „Wo?“ (where?). The article changes: der/das → dem, die → der.
grammar.0.note: Short rule: der-words and das-words → dem; die-words → der. (In the plural: den, plus -n at the end of the noun.)
grammar.1.title: Location words
grammar.2.title: liegen or stehen?
grammar.2.text: Things that lie flat: liegen (das Buch liegt auf dem Tisch, der Schlüssel liegt …). Things that are upright or standing: stehen (die Lampe steht, der Schrank steht). Pick the right verb in your answer — „ist“ also works, but liegt/steht sounds more natural.
quiz.7.prompt: Put the words in order: “The key is on the table.”
